results.title: Lead Engineer VOS
results.description: In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Participate in the handover meeting and discuss with sales and project management team on the project requirements and any deviations. Create a project timeline, notify the stakeholders, identify risks, and take appropriate action to reduce them. Drive the team to create wiring, schematic, and general arrangement drawings in accordance with the project specification Review manufacturing designs and the bill of materials Drive the team to meet their KPIs like RDSL, Quality, etc. working toward the goal. Prepare project metrics and review them weekly/monthly with higher management. Investigate and resolve operational problems from an engineering perspective. Encourage the team to put the needs of the customer foremost by understanding and meeting those demands with high Quality of Deliverables. Develop / Create standards in line with engineering processes and procedures Create work instructions to describe engineering best practices. Define goals and objectives for the team and review periodically Co-ordinate with cross-function departments Drive continuous process improvement initiatives to enhance quality and productivity of deliverables Who You Are: You promote high visibility of shared contributions to goals. You quickly and significantly act in constantly evolving, unexpected situations. You actively seek input from pertinent sources to make timely and well-informed decisions. You handle the risk that comes with moving forward when the outcome is not certain. You understand internal and external stakeholder requirements, expectations, and needs. You keep a strong bottom-line orientation. You come up with useful ideas that are new, better, or unique, introducing new ways of looking at problems. You ask the right questions to accurately analyze situations. You are an effective leader who drives team engagement. For This Role, You Will Need: Minimum 10-12 years of experience in CAD, PLM, ERP tool Excellent verbal and written communication skills To manage the flow of job in such a way that the priorities are given due attention and the work is completed on time. To use CAD tool to create Drawings based on the standard and to maintain Drawing Database Good Engineering knowledge required to apply concepts in Valve operating system Engineering. Demonstrate ability to work in a team environment. Ability to drive change and effectively handle multiple priorities. Experience in planning, delegating and mentoring a team. Identifying & planning upskilling of team members apart from regular day-to-day functional deliverables by the team. Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical engineering or equivalent Proficiency in Solid Edge, Teamcenter or any other equivalent CAD/PLM Tools Experience in working any ERP Tool, Oracle preferred Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical engineering or equivalent Proficiency in Solid Edge, Teamcenter or any other equivalent CAD/PLM Tools Experience in working any ERP Tool, Oracle preferred
